proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ I hI
  have hI' : (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using hI
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0, hle⟩ := NumberField.exists_ne_zero_mem_ideal_of_norm_le_mul_sqrt_discr K (Units.mk0 _ hI')
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (FractionalIdeal.mem_coeIdeal _).1 ha
  refine ⟨x, hx, by simpa using ha0, ?_⟩
  rw [Units.val_mk0, FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_absNorm] at hle
  have h3 := Algebra.coe_norm_int (K := K) x
  rw [← h3] at hle
  simpa using hle
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), I ≠ ⊥ → ∃ a ∈ I, a ≠ 0 ∧ (|Algebra.norm ℤ a| : ℝ) ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) * (4 / Real.pi) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ((Module.finrank ℚ K).factorial : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K * Real.sqrt |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|
